name: live-translation-app
description: Real-time Arabic to English meeting translator (Electron client + Node backend relay to Soniox).

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w packages/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w packages/server && npm run typecheck -w packages/client
scripts.package: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run bundle -w packages/server && npm run package -w packages/client
